Name: Pinkdew Valley
Author: FireflyFarmer
Description:
Still working on this one, but it's supposed to change the over all colors to be pink and fix up some buildings.

As of now this includes:

Pink House w/fixed hole in porch
Pink Shed
Pink Tinted Green House
Pink Well 
Pink Stable w/ fixed water trough and plant

Downloads.Description: Just unzip the file, then copy and paste what you want to replace.
